subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Big conclusions often rest on small repeated actions.”?
options: A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.
Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and visible.
Nature-based protection may look messy, but it can work with forces that hard structures only resist.
Sometimes improving the place where work happens helps the person doing the work.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Big conclusions often rest on small repeated actions. A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Clean air may be invisible, but the work to protect it must be regular and visible.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Nature-based protection may look messy, but it can work with forces that hard structures only resist.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes improving the place where work happens helps the person doing the work.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Big conclusions often rest on small repeated actions. A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.」，答案為「A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
